system.description:
You begin to turn one willing creatures body into a water vapor mist. All equipment the creature is wearing transforms as well for the duration.

While in this form, their only form of movement is flying. They gain 20 feet fly speed. It can enter and occupy the space of another creature and slip through tiny cracks wide enough for water vapor to fit through but it treats liquids as solid surfaces it cannot permeate.

It has resistance to all damage, excluding Earth damage and advantage on Strength, Dexterity, and Constitution Saving Throws.

The creature can make Stealth checks to be seen as a common cloud of gas, mist or fog.

While in this form of mist, they can’t talk or manipulate objects, and any objects it was carrying or holding can’t be dropped, used, or otherwise interacted with. They cannot attack or cast jutsu while in this form.
